Note row. End is exclusive, so Saturday 23:59 is outside both the trigger and the party rows: for that one minute the row greys with 'Saturdays, 9pm to 1am.', which is false at 23:59 Saturday. An end of 00:00 wraps to the same day (v2.py isCurrentTimeSlot) and would cover the minute, for the trigger and the rows alike.
One row, a group OR over Saturday and Sunday-after-midnight, show_when_blocked, and a cooldown naming the full hours.
